title: 高盛225亿美元收购Neos，加码期权ETF赛道
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We're joined by Bloomberg Finance reporter Catherine Doherty.
segments.zh: 我们请到了彭博财经记者凯瑟琳·多尔蒂。

segments.en: Is this considered a win for Goldman or is Goldman just putting itself out there with potential risk and riskier products just coming to market now as well?
segments.zh: 这是否被视为高盛的胜利，还是高盛只是在冒险，推出风险更高的产品？

segments.en: So I actually think that this product is intentionally meant to manage the risk.
segments.zh: 实际上，我认为这个产品是有意管理风险的。

segments.en: It's giving some upside but it is capping at the downside.
segments.zh: 它提供上行空间，但限制下行风险。

segments.en: So this acquisition is giving them access to options based ETFs.
segments.zh: 这次收购让他们获得了基于期权的ETF产品。

segments.en: This has grown organically, Nios is one of the biggest providers of such product.
segments.zh: 这类产品自然增长，Neos是最大的提供商之一。

segments.en: So for Goldman they have the choice of either to build their own in-house organically or do what they did today which is acquire an established player and add into their now expanding offering
segments.zh: 高盛可以选择自己开发，或者像今天这样收购成熟玩家，扩大其产品线。

segments.en: within their asset management business of ETF products.
segments.zh: 在其资管业务中增加ETF产品。

segments.en: So that's what you're seeing with this $2.25 billion acquisition.
segments.zh: 这就是你看到的22.5亿美元收购。

segments.en: Size won't no doubt. Let's step back here. What does it say kind of directly about the tech that Goldman is taking?
segments.zh: 规模无疑很重要。让我们退一步看，这直接说明了高盛采用的技术是什么？

segments.en: I do think that there has been a shift especially that Goldman has shown with its pocketbook to ETF products.
segments.zh: 我认为确实出现了转变，尤其是高盛通过其资金投入ETF产品所展现的。

segments.en: So again we have a lot of asset managers even outside of Goldman that are looking at ETFs as an attractive product because you can get substantial upside but also with certain products
segments.zh: 所以，除了高盛，许多资管机构也将ETF视为有吸引力的产品，因为既能获得可观的上行收益，同时某些产品还能

segments.en: like this one you can manage the risks of the downside.
segments.zh: 像这样的产品，可以管理下行风险。
